v1.meaning: Alice is married under §7703(a) as of the close of 2018

v2.meaning: Alice files a separate return for 2018 (not a joint return)

v3.meaning: Alice maintains as her home a household which constitutes for more than half the year the principal place of abode of a child for whom she is entitled to a §151 deduction

v4.meaning: Alice furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining that household during 2018

v5.meaning: During the last 6 months of 2018, Alice's spouse is not a member of that household

program.target: §7703(b)(2) Determination of marital status — Notwithstanding §7703(a), a married individual who files a separate return and maintains as home the household of a child for more than half the year, and who furnishes over half the cost of maintaining that household, and whose spouse is not a member of the household during the last 6 months, shall not be considered married.

direct.text: Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob have a son, Charlie, who was born on September 16th, 2017. Alice and Charlie live in a home maintained by Alice since September 16th, 2017. Alice is entitled to a deduction for Charlie under section 151(c) for the years 2017 to 2019. Alice and Bob file a separate return for the years 2017 to 2019.
